steps.path: Click Preview on a conversation the assistant found for you
steps.headline: The side-panel preview now matches the Projects preview: resume card at the bottom, Complete beside the tag button.
steps.changed: The Resume button left the top bar. At the foot of the preview is the same card as the Projects preview: tags, the project and date, the model picker, Skip Permissions and Resume Session. The top bar now reads tag · complete · expand · close, and the tag sheet offers Priority.
steps.notice: You pick the model right in the panel instead of opening a small popup first. When a conversation cannot be resumed here, the card says why in words instead of a greyed-out button.
steps.risk: No Launch in New Window switch here: a resume from this panel always opens a tab, as you chose for chat-search resumes. There is no file size in the details line, because the search index does not record it. The card takes about a third of the panel's height, so less conversation shows at once.

steps.headline: The first-message line is gone from the Projects conversation cards, as in the Resume browser.
steps.changed: Cards now show only the title, tags, and the model · size … date line. The app also stopped reading each conversation's file to find that line.
steps.notice: Shorter cards, and the Conversations tab has a little less work to do when it opens.
